Gribskov is a Danish municipality that is tracked for clinical quality metrics regarding the treatment of atrial fibrillation [^src1]. It is featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The report evaluates healthcare quality across all 98 Danish municipalities, serving as a vital tool for local benchmarking and quality improvement within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Gribskov's specific municipal data is included in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation therapy among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. These specific calculations rely on data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. In the report's detailed municipal breakdown, Gribskov is listed with statistical outputs detailing patient counts and stroke events—specifically noting figures such as "10 / 1.253" and "13 / 1.256"—alongside corresponding standardized rates and confidence intervals [^src1].
